look: half-B confirmation of T-R3 (not a discovery look; does not spend a Q4 look)
sealed_before: the first load of any half-B row

what_is_inherited_unchanged: universe: the sixteen ETFs in five classes; SHY the cash proxy and risk-free leg
RULE-CASH-NOT-A-WEIGHTED-CLASS and RULE-TURNOVER-AGGREGATED-BY-ASSET and RULE-DRIFT-THEN-REBALANCE and RULE-WORST-12-MONTHS
eligibility: ten month-end closes; class weight 1/(classes with an eligible member); equal weight within class; monthly rebalance
the ten-month rule: hold the ETF when the month-end closeadj is above the mean of its last ten month-end closeadj (current month included), else hold SHY
costs: 5 bps per side base, 15 bps STRESS, on traded notional aggregated by asset; no financing; taxes ignored
Sharpe: annualised, on monthly returns in excess of SHY, std ddof=1
the statistic dSR = Sharpe(TREND net) - Sharpe(BUY-AND-HOLD net) over the same months
the voting null: 2000 two-state Markov random-timing books at each sleeve's OWN measured rates, measured from the book under test; p = share with dSR >= the observed dSR
R values: R_VOTING 2000, known-null N 200 x R 500, positive control N 50 x R 500, bootstrap R 5000 mean block 6 one shared index
the seed policy: SEED_VOTING 20261005, SEED_CONTROL 777, SEED_PLANT 4242, SEED_BOOT 20261005
both controls and their pass rules: known-null share at p<=0.05 in [0.01, 0.10]; positive control detection >= 0.80 at a q calibrated on ONE draw to dSR about 0.4

vintage.label: funds_20261005f
vintage.note: the look reads data already on disk; no vendor request is issued

engine.rule: NOT edited in this sprint; any change is a HALT, asserted in code and by a test

window.warm_up: the state for 2013-01 is formed from month-end closes through 2012-12; pre-2013 rows are signal inputs only and are never scored
window.holdout: nothing dated 2021-01-01 or later is loaded: filtered at read AND asserted after load, with a test proving the guard bites on a constructed 2021 row
window.first_month_buy_in: the first scored month pays a full 1.0 turnover buy-in in BOTH books, the same convention half A used at 2002-08; it very largely cancels in dSR

interpretation_ruling.question: The brief says the engine is not edited and 'the runner may gain a window parameter, nothing else'.
interpretation_ruling.ruling: The window is parameterised in a NEW runner, tools/run_t_r3b.py, which imports the UNCHANGED engine. tools/run_t_r3.py is left byte-identical.
grounds: the constraint that matters is that the measurement is unchanged, and it is: the engine is untouched and sha-asserted at run time
T-R3's banked artifact and ledger row must stay reproducible from the script that produced them; editing run_t_r3.py would break that
R3b needs more than a window anyway (per-calendar-year sub-reads, ex-2020, the joined descriptive block, its own decision rule and its own ledger batch), none of which belongs in the T-R3 runner
interpretation_ruling.what_the_runner_does_to_the_window: it builds the panel exactly as registered from the full pre-2021 history and then SLICES the scored rows to 2013-01..2020-12; slicing after the build is what makes the 2013-01 state identical to the registered construction

order_of_operations: 1. MDE from the half-B null's spread
2. KNOWN-NULL CONTROL: 200 random books as observed, fresh 500-book null each; share at p<=0.05 in [0.01, 0.10] or HALT
3. POSITIVE CONTROL: q calibrated on ONE half-B draw to dSR about 0.4; 50 fresh draws; detection >= 0.80 or HALT
5. DESCRIPTIVE ONLY: the two halves joined
observed_emissions: per book: CAGR, annual vol, Sharpe, maximum drawdown, worst rolling 12 months
paired bootstrap 90% intervals for dSR and for the mean monthly return difference - REPORTED, NOT VOTING
time in cash by class; switches per year
dSR excluding calendar 2020 - DESCRIPTIVE, the one fast crash in the window
the six-class variant - reported, NOT voted

joined_block.status: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, labelled as such because half A has been seen
emissions: both books' CAGR, vol, Sharpe, maximum drawdown

prior_stated_now: CONSISTENT or REJECT. 2013-2020 is a long advance broken by fast reversals (2015-16, late 2018, March 2020), in which a monthly rule exits late and re-enters late; the literature reports timing roughly matching or trailing buy-and-hold over this stretch. The half-A result rested about four-fifths on 2008.
